scope: One actual plugin-selected pending operation: legal recovery, verified arrival, guarded new execution, and persisted verified completion of the same original plan occurrence. No exhaustion claim.
entry: ExplorerPlugin.start(existingTaskId), using scripts/okx-plugin-loop-acceptance.ts --run <prepared independent directory> --evidence <this directory>
input: A byte copy of the closed v8 engine and plugin databases, independent mutable files, immutable evidence blobs may be hard-linked. Preserve original task plan, scope authority, route debt, session permissions, budgets and usage.

preparationContract.file: preparation.json in this evidence directory, supplied by the parent before execution
preparationContract.ownership: Copied owner.json must name the independent canonical destination and existing taskId. The harness never opens source databases and rejects hard-linked mutable databases. The parent verifies source hashes before and after.

window.externalSupervisor: Parent supplies the run20-style owned process supervisor. An unsettled or killed process never passes. No extension or automatic rerun.

configuration: Both real providers must be configured through providersFromEnv before databases or browsers are opened. Only call counts and durations are reported; no environment files, secrets, provider request state or responses are copied by this harness.
closedLoop: The baseline item is required, concrete, unfinished, and has no successful attempt or resolution; its occurrence ID and full prior evidence are retained.

The plugin chooses either explicit verified recovery with at least one actual successful recovery attempt, or a guarded prerequisite reentry from retained route evidence. For reentry, branch.reentry_planned binds the baseline child occurrence and its original target observation; historical route receipts and the original repetitionSource must agree with the new guarded successful entry receipt. Entry success alone is insufficient.
The plugin independently emits action.selected and action.scheduled for the same item; the harness forwards the original SDK action, request, value and guard unchanged.
A read-only SDK correspondence binds that chosen action to the unique historical action matching the selected item's scope. A correspondence read never authorizes dispatch.

For guarded reentry, SDK target correspondence and the later successful observation-bound target dispatch establish continuing interaction with that pending child; this is not a fabricated whole-checkpoint REACHED result.
The actual non-recovery, non-reentry receipt succeeds under the original observation-bound exploration guard, has complete before/after observations, and is byte-equivalent to its persisted receipt.

After recordOutcome is persisted, the same occurrence is succeeded, resolvedBy and conditionCompletion.source reference the new receipt, conditionCompletion is verified, and the fresh SDK receipt condition is verified.
The session and task have no unknown/executing, dirty, pendingDispatch, unverifiedRecovery or unverifiedNavigation. The harness then requests ordinary plugin pause and waits for settlement.
failureStops: First returned unverified recovery or thrown recovery
plugin halt without a complete loop
Missing, changed or unverified boundary exit result stops synchronously before the queued completion audit
notAllowed: Selecting SDK actions in the harness
Replacing plugin inputs with 2/3 or other samples
Changing plan, permissions, groups, source paths or route debt
Calling private scheduler/step methods as the real entry
Treating review completion, candidate readiness, a new observation or unrelated action success as the closed loop
limits: Successful continuation and condition completion are separate checks. Novelty is relative to the retained input and chosen pending occurrence, not all experiments or all semantic branches. This is one bounded real chain, not an automatic exploration success rate or a performance comparison. API timings overlap. The changed reentry oracle requires independent review and targeted tests before launch. Prior failed windows remain failed. No strict wall-clock speedup claim from this single live trial.
rerunReason: b40abdb replaces full historical observation materialization with bounded snapshot reads; complete saved frontier equality and 67 targeted tests passed. The harness also explicitly recognizes the existing guarded reentry route without selecting actions or relaxing arrival/dispatch/completion checks.
measurementAddition: Existing aggregate host counters and actual recovery-result timings. API inclusive timings overlap. No stage budget, target choice, permission or input changes. If no explicit recovery occurs, report that as not exercised, never zero-time success.
